emails.subject: Your copy of The Warrior's Roadmap, Milestone 1
emails.preview: Save it somewhere you'll find it, and grab a pen before you start.

lines: Hi {{contact.first_name}},
Thank you for asking for the first part of The Warrior's Roadmap. In case you closed the page before you saved it, your copy is right here.
Save it to your phone or print it, whichever one you'll actually open.

When you sit down with it, have a pen and a piece of paper next to you. Read the opening pages, and when you get to the Authority Audit, stop and write. Don't answer what sounds spiritual. Answer what's real.
You'll also start getting my devotionals by email.
Until next time, may God grant you and yours his strength for today.
Pastor Jeff Kaplan
Strength for Today

emails.who: Goes to everyone who signs up, even if they already own the book.

emails.subject: When you're under pressure, whose voice gets the loudest?
emails.preview: It's one of the four questions in the first part of the Roadmap, and it's worth an evening this week.

lines: Hi {{contact.first_name}},
When you're under pressure, whose voice gets the loudest in your mind?

That's one of four questions I ask you to answer on paper in the first part of The Warrior's Roadmap. Maybe you've already written your answers down. Maybe your copy is still sitting in your downloads. Either way, I'd like for you to set aside one evening this week for that question.

It matters because when life gets hard, whatever has been acting as your authority will show itself. Pressure always reveals the foundation. I'd rather you find out what you're standing on now, with a pen in your hand, than when the ground starts to move.
So be honest with it. Nobody else has to see your answers. God already knows them, and He works with the truth.
Until next time, may God grant you and yours his strength for today.
Pastor Jeff Kaplan
Strength for Today

emails.who: Anyone who has bought the book doesn't get this one.

emails.subject: Did you get to sit down with the Roadmap?
emails.preview: If you did, you've already done something a lot of believers never do.

lines: Hi {{contact.first_name}},
Did you get a chance to sit down with the first part of The Warrior's Roadmap this week?
If you did, you've already done something a lot of believers never do. You wrote down, honestly, what has really been acting as your authority. That's not a small thing, and I'm grateful you did it.
If you haven't started yet, that's alright. Your copy is still here: https://strengthfortodaywithdrj.com/roadmap-preview-download/
One evening and a pen is all it takes to begin.

I'm writing because of what comes next. Once you settle what has the right to tell you what's true, the Bible starts talking about you. And the very next question you'll run into is this one: who does God say you are?
That's what the second part of the Roadmap is about. It's called Formation, and it takes you through examining your current identity, dying to self, and embracing your new identity in Christ.
If you're still working through the first part, that's good. Take your time - the next part will be there when you're ready.

When you are, the full Warrior's Roadmap has all three Milestones in one book. It's $27, an instant download, and it starts with the same first Milestone you already have, so you can turn straight to Milestone 2.
If you already have the full Roadmap, thank you. Turn to Milestone 2 and keep going.
Either way, keep your answers where you can see them, and keep your Bible open.
Until next time, may God grant you and yours his strength for today.
Pastor Jeff Kaplan
Strength for Today

emails.who: Anyone who has bought the book doesn't get this one.

emails.subject: Who does God say you are?
emails.preview: A few lines from the second part of the Roadmap, in case that question has been on your mind.

lines: Hi {{contact.first_name}},
Last week I mentioned the question that comes after the first part of the Roadmap: who does God say you are?
I want to share how the second part begins, because I think a lot of us live right in this spot. This is the opening of Step 4:
"Before God reshapes your life, He reshapes how you see yourself.

Many believers sincerely love Christ and believe the gospel, yet still carry an identity that was formed long before grace ever had a voice in their lives. They have been forgiven, but not fully freed. Redeemed, but not fully restored. Saved, but still standing in the shadow of who they used to be.
They believe God has moved on.
They are not so sure they have."

If that's where you are, my friend, good. That's an honest place to start. But don't stop there. Step 4 walks you through where those old labels came from and what Scripture says about who you are now.
The full Warrior's Roadmap is $27, an instant download, and Milestone 2 picks up right after the part you already have.
If you already have it, turn to Step 4 and start there.
Either way, my devotionals will keep coming.
Until next time, may God grant you and yours his strength for today.
Pastor Jeff Kaplan
Strength for Today
